title: Reduced radical analyzer Project Security Review
content:
## Summary

This technical design document belongs to Reduced radical analyzer Project, which the company is delivering for Quantum Technologies. ERP Integration initiative focused on enterprise transformation. It describes how the solution is built, in enough detail for engineers to implement and maintain it. This document focuses on the security review.

## Project details

- **Project:** Reduced radical analyzer Project (PRJ-2026-00094)
- **Client:** Quantum Technologies
- **Department:** Marketing
- **Project manager:** Vihaan Chander
- **Project status:** On Hold, priority High
- **Timeline:** 2024-08-20 to 2026-09-05
- **Document type:** Technical Design Document
- **Prepared by:** Frado Behl on 2026-08-04

## Scope of the review

The review looked at authentication, authorisation, data protection, logging and the security of the build and release process.

## Findings

- User sessions expire after a period of inactivity, and tokens are signed and time-limited.
- Data is encrypted in transit and at rest. Encryption keys are held in the approved secrets store.
- Logging of failed sign-in attempts was incomplete and has been added to the backlog as a high-priority task.
- No critical findings remain open at the time of writing.

## Recommendations

Upgrade the affected dependencies before the next release, repeat the automated scan, and schedule a penetration test before go-live.

## Document control

This is an internal document. It is kept in the project repository, and changes are approved by the project manager. Questions about its content go to the author.
